payer_name.rationale: PayerName/BusinessNameLine1Txt maps to the cooperative's primary name line in the payer information block.

payer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street address into one string; canonical splits PayerUSAddress into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields and map to PayerUSAddress sub-elements.

payer_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/ZIP into one string; canonical PayerUSAddress splits these into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd — blueprint should split into 3 separate fields.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly corresponds to the payer's TIN box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the canonical element for the recipient's TIN (SSN/EIN/ITIN) on Form 1099-PATR; RecipientEIN at idx 30 is an alternative but RecipientSSN is the primary field.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the recipient (patron) name box.

recipient_address.rationale: RecipientUSAddress/AddressLine1Txt is the best match for the recipient's street address, assuming a domestic address; blueprint should split street/city/state/zip into separate fields.

recipient_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/ZIP into one string; canonical RecipientUSAddress splits these into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd — blueprint should split into 3 separate fields.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly corresponds to the account number assigned by the cooperative to the patron.

tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps to the calendar year printed near the top of the form.

box_1_patronage_dividends.rationale: PatronageDividendsAmt directly corresponds to Box 1 — Patronage dividends.

box_2_nonpatronage_distributions.rationale: NonpatronageDistributionsAmt directly corresponds to Box 2 — Nonpatronage distributions.

box_3_per_unit_retain_allocations.rationale: PerUnitRetainAllocationsAmt directly corresponds to Box 3 — Per-unit retain allocations.

box_4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly corresponds to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

box_5_redemption_of_nonqualified_notices.rationale: RedeemedNonqualifiedNoticesAmt directly corresponds to Box 5 — Redemption of nonqualified notices and retain allocations.

box_6_section_199a_g_deduction.rationale: Section199AgDeductionAmt directly corresponds to Box 6 — Section 199A(g) deduction.

box_7_qualified_payments.rationale: Section199Ab7QualifiedPymtAmt directly corresponds to Box 7 — Qualified payments under section 199A(b)(7).

box_8_section_199a_qualified_items.rationale: Section199AaQualifiedItemsAmt directly corresponds to Box 8 — Section 199A(a) qualified items income or loss.

box_9_section_199a_w2_wages.rationale: No candidate element for Section 199A(a) W-2 wages (Box 9) exists in the supplied canonical list; this field has no matching element.

box_10_section_199a_unadjusted_basis.rationale: No candidate element for Section 199A(a) unadjusted basis (Box 10) exists in the supplied canonical list; this field has no matching element.

box_11_specified_coop_patron.rationale: SpecifiedCooperativeInd directly corresponds to Box 11 — Specified cooperative patron checkbox.

state_1.rationale: Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateAbbreviationCd maps to the first state abbreviation; the schema supports multiple instances of the group for state 1 and state 2.

state_1_id_number.rationale: Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateIdNum maps to the payer's state identification number for the first state.

state_1_tax_withheld.rationale: Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateTaxWithheldAmt maps to state income tax withheld for the first state.

state_2.rationale: The second state uses a second instance of Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateAbbreviationCd; same element index as state_1 because the schema repeats the group.

state_2_id_number.rationale: The second state uses a second instance of Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateIdNum; same element index as state_1_id_number because the schema repeats the group.

state_2_tax_withheld.rationale: The second state uses a second instance of Form1099PATRStateLocalTaxGrp/StateTaxWithheldAmt; same element index as state_1_tax_withheld because the schema repeats the group.
